basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Computer Science at the HKUST NLP Group, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, supervised by Professor Junxian He. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning.

work.name: Shanghai AI Lab

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
